resumeText:
Ananya Iyer | Bengaluru | ananya.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Category Manager - Personal Care, ZipKart Quick Commerce, Bengaluru (2023 - present)
- Expanded personal care assortment from 1,800 to 3,200 SKUs using search gap and sales data.
- Onboarded 45 new D2C brands and sellers onto the platform in 18 months.
- Planned pricing and promotions for monthly sale events with brand funding.
- Owned category GMV and margin targets for a 40 crore rupee annual business.
- Negotiated margins and promotion funding with brand partners every quarter.
- Worked with supply, marketing and dark store operations teams on new launches.

Assistant Category Manager - Home, ShopNova Marketplace, Bengaluru (2020 - 2023)
- Built weekly GMV, fill rate and margin trackers in Excel for the home category.
- Ran seller reviews on returns and ratings.

EDUCATION
MBA Marketing, Christ University, 2020

SKILLS
Catalogue quality, Category analytics, Vendor negotiation
